head: 1f725cedc5c8b092c8a3d7e408793ef72840ec7e
notes: Many style defects in this chunk are already in the known ledger and were not re-reported. These include the 'Never translate' enumerations over 6 items (the known smine-batch L35 row covers the 8-10-item sentences across the dimension skills), the duplicated Casual presentation bullets, the 11-key args spans in smine SKILL.md, the outcome enumerations in smine-apply, the changelog ordering, the 0.1.0 version, the named person, the missing Skill map links and the stale MINE_SCHEMA example. Cross-chunk/other-direction suspicion for the station: smine SKILL.md L49 describes what the workflow encodes but leaves out the Drift stage that session-mine.js now runs first. The primary path at L48 runs no drift check at all, so the two run paths diverge. This was not chased, because it is correctness, not style.

findings.claim: The new step-4 permissions branch states the same deny/ask prohibition twice in one clause: 'never touch `deny`/`ask`; ... do **not** edit settings — allow-rules only, never a deny/ask edit;'. The second occurrence adds no instruction and is paid on every smine-apply invocation.
findings.evidence: Re-read skills/smine/smine-apply/SKILL.md L31 at 1f725ce (the **permissions** branch added in this diff): 'keeping the array's existing sort order; never touch `deny`/`ask`; if the rule is already present in `allow` (a race), archive to `done.md` with an `already-present` note and do **not** edit settings — allow-rules only, never a deny/ask edit;'. Both phrases forbid the same thing; no other branch in the step repeats its guard. Not covered by the known ledger (smine-apply L31 known rows concern auto-apply reachability, casual lockout scope and the origin: user restatement).
findings.fix: Drop the trailing ' — allow-rules only, never a deny/ask edit' so the branch ends '... do **not** edit settings;'.

findings.claim: The new Subagent mining subsection restates what the --subagents Args bullet already says and carries rationale in the body: L71 'Off by default' and L73 'Cost: one extra paginated pull per subagent — this is why it is opt-in. Only run it when explicitly enabled.' repeat L29 ('Off by default — it costs one extra paginated session_get/session_events pull per subagent'). Rationale ('this is why it is opt-in') belongs in README, not the executed body.
findings.evidence: Re-read skills/smine/smine-batch/SKILL.md L29 (Args: '--subagents: ... Off by default — it costs one extra paginated `session_get`/`session_events` pull per subagent.'), L71 ('Off by default: without the flag, only the top-level transcript ... are mined (current behavior).') and L73 ('Cost: one extra paginated pull per subagent — this is why it is opt-in. Only run it when explicitly enabled.'). L73 carries no instruction beyond L29/L71; its 'this is why' clause is a Why the skill-format rule moves to README. Known ledger rows for smine-batch (L33 tool list, L34/L35/L42/L44/L58) do not cover this.
findings.fix: Delete L73 and the '(current behavior)' tail of L71; keep the cost note only in the L29 Args bullet.

findings.claim: The bootstrap Args bullet says the same thing twice: '(lenient on seeding volume, strict on schema, audit, and style)' and then 'You are the initial setup agent: the machine is being seeded, large output volume is expected and acceptable.' The second sentence restates 'lenient on seeding volume' and adds no instruction.
findings.evidence: Re-read skills/smine/smine-orchestrate/SKILL.md L24 at 1f725ce (new file). The parenthetical already sets the volume leniency; the trailing sentence repeats it in persona form. No other entry relies on the second sentence. Known rows for this file (L18 clean-tree precondition, L19 Skill map link, L57 context.json, L61 additionalDirectories) do not cover it.
findings.fix: Delete the sentence 'You are the initial setup agent: the machine is being seeded, large output volume is expected and acceptable.'

findings.claim: The three skills created in this change (smine-permissions, smine-orchestrate, smine-style) are authored in the legacy layout — '## When to use' with Use when/Don't use when lines, plus free-prose '## Hard invariants'/'## Rules'/'## Steps' sections — instead of the fixed skill layout (## Routing with Purpose, Disambiguation table, Preconditions, Pipeline; entries only, no floating prose). New skills start out of format and inherit a later /fmt migration.
findings.evidence: Re-read skills/smine/smine-permissions/SKILL.md L14 ('## When to use'), L72 ('## Rules'); skills/smine/smine-orchestrate/SKILL.md L14 ('## When to use'), L27 ('## Hard invariants'); skills/smine/smine-style/SKILL.md L14 ('## When to use'), L25 ('## Steps'), L37 ('## Hard invariants'). context/rules/skills.md RULE-SKILL-011 fixes the layout as frontmatter, title, purpose, ## Routing (Purpose, Disambiguation table, Preconditions, Pipeline), ## Args, topic sections of entries only, ## Model; RULE-SKILL-008 shows the format rules bind legacy skills as review rules. Sibling smine skills share the legacy layout, which explains but does not exempt newly created files. Not in the known ledger.
findings.fix: Author the three new skills in the fixed layout: replace '## When to use' with '## Routing' (Purpose, Disambiguation table, Preconditions, Pipeline) and turn the Hard invariants/Rules/Steps bullets into entries.
